info.title: MLOps Platform API
info.description:
Multi-tenant labeling-platform backend. Login is account-level (ADR-0113): `GET /auth/authorize` → hosted sign-in → `POST /auth/callback` → Bearer token. Workspace membership is resolved per-request: endpoints under `/tenants/{slug}` match the token's `sub` against that tenant's membership table; non-members are rejected with 403. The account surface (`/me/*`) lists workspaces and handles invitation accept/decline.

**Error envelope** (any 4xx/5xx, ADR-0034): `{"error": {"code": str, "message": str, "hint": str|null, "details": object|null, "request_id": str}}`. The `code` field is a stable enum (`components.schemas.ErrorCode`); pattern-match on `code`, not on `message`. The `hint` field, when present, suggests a concrete next step.

**Pagination** (cursor-based, see ADR-0012): list endpoints return `{"items": [...], "next_cursor": str | null}`. Pass `?cursor=` for the next page. No total counts.

**Idempotency**: bulk-op POSTs accept an `Idempotency-Key` header to deduplicate retries (ADR-0023).

post.description:
Mints a new long-lived credential bound to the calling user. The plaintext is returned **once** in this response — store it securely (env var, secret manager). The server only retains an argon2id hash, so a lost plaintext cannot be recovered; revoke and re-create.

Use the returned `plaintext` as a `Authorization: Bearer <plaintext>` header to authenticate subsequent requests. The key inherits the user's role; v1 has no scoping.

**Capped at 1 active key per user.** To rotate, `DELETE` your existing key first, then `POST` to mint a fresh one. Without scopes there's no functional reason to hold more than one.

post.description:
Fan-out of `/upload-init` for SDK / CLI ingest workflows: the caller passes up to 100 files, the server returns one presigned URL per file. Slashes the per-file RPC count by ~100×, which is the dominant cost when ingesting a folder of small images.

Per-file failures (wrong MIME, oversized, etc.) are returned with `upload_type='error'` instead of failing the whole batch — the client maps responses back to inputs via `client_ref` and retries or skips individual items.

Files larger than the multipart threshold return `error_code='USE_PER_FILE_INIT'`; the caller falls back to the regular `/upload-init` for those (multipart needs per-part presigning that doesn't fit a batch shape).

**`X-Upload-Session-Id` header (optional, ADR-0039)**: pass a UUID and the server uses it as the rollup correlation_id for every file in this call. SDK clients reuse one UUID across all chunks of one logical `upload()` invocation so the activity feed shows a single *"uploaded N assets"* row instead of one row per 100-file chunk. When omitted, the server mints a fresh UUID per call (current default; backwards compatible).

post.description:
Multimodal similarity search over the dataset's embedded assets (ADR-0033).

Top-K (default 50, max 200), no pagination. Filters AND the vector ranking
— items that don't match the filters are excluded even if visually identical.
Only assets with `embedding_status = 'ready'` participate; unembedded assets
are skipped.

`query.parts` is an ordered list of {text|image_uri|asset_id} blocks; the
model accepts mixed inputs in one query. `query.instruction` is optional
(server picks a default per dataset kind; must be English for the
retrieval-quality boost — ADR-0033).

get.description:
List a version's **frozen** assets — the durable snapshot, not live rows
(ADR-0065 Phase 3). Backed by `version_asset_index`, so it survives asset
deletion: an asset removed from the dataset since freeze still appears here,

frozen asset carries any annotation — plus the negative twins `?tags_none=`,

workflow state isn't frozen). `total` is the count matching the filter. Each item carries frozen
filename/dims/tags + thumbnail + full image URL — everything the grid/list
needs without a live-row or manifest read.

Read-only by nature; near-1:1 with the live asset list except editing and
embedding/semantic search (a version_only asset has no embedding — the vector
is CASCADE-dropped with the asset, and versions don't freeze vectors).

Duplicate a project as a CONFIGURATION + data-selection clone (ADR-0122).

Copies everything that defines *how the project is set up*: classes +
attributes, members + roles, tag policy, auto-label config, guidelines

29s cap. Either way the new project is returned at once, fully configured.

AutoLabelRunRequest.title: AutoLabelRunRequest
AutoLabelRunRequest.description:
Start a batch pre-label run. Exactly one of `asset_ids` / `all` (`all` = every
asset in the project).

Existing-annotation policy is a single 3-level funnel (ADR-0075 rev 2) — easy to
reason about, and **human work is always protected**: a bulk run NEVER deletes or
replaces a human-made (manual/imported) annotation; only AI-generated (`model`)
annotations are ever cleared.

  1. `skip_annotated` (default true) — only label assets with zero annotations.
     The safe "pre-label the untouched pile". If false, drill into 2.
  2. `on_existing` — for assets that already have annotations:
       • "overwrite" → clear the asset's AI labels and write fresh AI (human kept);
         the "I retrained, refresh the un-reviewed pile" case.
       • "append" (default) → keep everything, add new AI, per 3.
  3. `on_overlap` — when an appended prediction overlaps an existing annotation:
       • "respect" (default) → drop the prediction (fill only the gaps that a
         human/AI annotation didn't already cover).
       • "replace" → the prediction wins over an overlapping *AI* annotation
         (deletes it); over a *human* annotation it always yields (human protected).

`on_existing` / `on_overlap` are ignored when `skip_annotated` is true. Overlap is
IoU-gated on bounding boxes (polygons by their bounds — a v1 approximation).

target.description: Kind-specific parameters describing what the job operates on (shape varies per `kind`; internal orchestration fields are omitted).

status.description: Current lifecycle state of the job.

total.title: Total
total.description: Total number of work items the job will process.

processed.title: Processed
processed.description: Number of work items processed so far.

succeeded.title: Succeeded
succeeded.description: Number of processed items that succeeded.

failed.title: Failed
failed.description: Number of processed items that failed.

skipped.title: Skipped
skipped.description: Number of items skipped (ineligible / already in target state).

error.title: Error
error.description: Failure message when the job errored, else null.

result_summary.title: Result Summary
result_summary.description: Kind-specific summary of the outcome, populated as the job runs and finishes. Stays a plain object here because the key set varies per `kind` (the union isn't a useful client type); the per-kind keys are registry-validated on the write side (`app/job_results.py`), so a given `kind` always carries the same shape.

created_by.title: Created By
created_by.description: User who created the job, or null if system-initiated.

completed_at.title: Completed At
completed_at.description: When the job reached a terminal state, or null if still in flight.

pct.title: Pct
pct.description:
Derived progress percent. A COMPLETED job is always 100 — even a no-op
with total==0 finished all of its (zero) work; showing 0/null on a done job
was misleading. Otherwise processed/total, or None when total is unknown
(freshly-queued, denominator not yet resolved).

KeypointPosition.title: KeypointPosition
KeypointPosition.description:
Normalized (0-1) (x, y) inside a unit bbox. Origin is top-left; y grows
down. The FE multiplies by the drawn bbox dimensions to seed each joint
when the user creates a new keypoint annotation by dragging a rect.

KeypointTopology.title: KeypointTopology
KeypointTopology.description:
Per-label keypoint topology — names the nodes, defines skeleton edges.
ADR-0030. Stored on `ProjectClass.keypoint_topology` as JSONB.

`nodes` are 0-indexed by their position in the array; the `id` field is
the explicit canonical index and MUST equal the array index. `edges` are
0-indexed pairs into `nodes`. Empty `edges` = single-keypoint label
(no skeleton render).

asset.description: Asset metadata for the labeler page.

download_url.title: Download Url
download_url.description: Presigned GET URL for the asset's full-resolution bytes.

shapes.title: Shapes
shapes.description: All annotations on the asset in this project.

LabelingContext.title: LabelingContext
LabelingContext.description:
Bundled labeler-page payload: state + asset metadata + annotations + classes
+ presigned download URL. One round-trip instead of four.

`annotations` (legacy) is kept for backward-compat — it equals `shapes`.
New FE code should read `shapes` directly.

asset_id.title: Asset Id
asset_id.description: Project asset the labeler is actively working on.

class_id.title: Class Id
class_id.description: Project class currently being labeled, if any. Omit when the active time isn't attributable to a specific class.

active_seconds.title: Active Seconds
active_seconds.description: Active seconds since the previous heartbeat. Capped at 30s (= 2× the 15s heartbeat cadence) to prevent crafted-payload inflation.

heartbeat_id.title: Heartbeat Id
heartbeat_id.description: Client-generated UUID v4 per heartbeat. Server deduplicates within a 5-minute sliding window per user; replays are silently no-op'd (204).

LabelingTimeHeartbeat.title: LabelingTimeHeartbeat
LabelingTimeHeartbeat.description:
Body of POST /labeling-time/heartbeat. Fired by the FE every ~15s
while a labeler is actively working on a project asset.

items.title: Items
items.description: Aggregated labeling-time rows, one per group_by dimension combination.

user_id.title: User Id
user_id.description: Labeler this row aggregates, when group_by includes 'user'.

class_id.title: Class Id
class_id.description: Project class this row aggregates, when group_by includes 'class'.

asset_id.title: Asset Id
asset_id.description: Project asset this row aggregates, when group_by includes 'asset'.

day.title: Day
day.description: Calendar day this row aggregates, when group_by includes 'day'.

total_seconds.title: Total Seconds
total_seconds.description: Total active labeling seconds for this row's dimension combination.

LabelingTimeRow.title: LabelingTimeRow
LabelingTimeRow.description:
One report row. Columns are populated when their dimension is in
the group_by list — otherwise they're absent (treated as aggregated).

MappedAnnotationCreate.title: MappedAnnotationCreate
MappedAnnotationCreate.description:
One row of a project-scoped flat create. References its target asset by
`asset_id` (UUID) or `filename` (resolved within the project's dataset via
the unique (dataset, filename) index); `asset_id` wins if both are given.
Geometry rules match `AnnotationCreate`. No `parent_id` — cross-row parent
links aren't expressible in a flat mapped list.

MemberPage.title: MemberPage
MemberPage.description:
ADR-0012 pagination envelope for the member listing. The member set is
bounded (ADR-0078 caps `MAX_MEMBERS_PER_PROJECT` at <=50) and returned whole,
so `next_cursor` is always None — the shape exists for contract uniformity.

role.description: Member's project role (manager, reviewer, or labeler).

user.description: Member profile; populated by routes that JOIN, else None.

ModelRef.title: ModelRef
ModelRef.description:
Which model auto-label uses. `deployment` = a trained-model SageMaker
endpoint (batch + assist); `foundation` = an open-vocab model like ZERO
(assist only — see ADR-0075).

ModelRefKind.title: ModelRefKind
ModelRefKind.description: Which model backs an auto-label run (stored in project.auto_label_config JSONB).

invited_by_email.title: Invited By Email
invited_by_email.description: Email of the admin who sent it, when still resolvable.

expires_at.title: Expires At
expires_at.description: After this, the invitation can't be accepted.

MyInvitation.title: MyInvitation
MyInvitation.description:
A pending invitation addressed to this account's email
(`GET /me/invitations` item). Accept/decline via its id.

items.title: Items
items.description: Pending, unexpired invitations whose email exactly matches the account's email.

items.title: Items
items.description: Every workspace this account belongs to. Unpaginated — bounded by how many workspaces one person can realistically join.

OutputGeometry.title: OutputGeometry
OutputGeometry.description:
Geometry kinds a model can emit (subset of AnnotationType). Used by the
serving/deployment + foundation-model capability descriptors.

OverallMetrics.title: OverallMetrics
OverallMetrics.description:
Overall detection/segmentation metrics at the F1-optimal confidence.
`map`/`map_50` are injected post-hoc by `trainer._score_split` (torchmetrics),
so `evaluate()` returns them unset — hence Optional-with-default.

email.title: Email
email.description: Email address of the tenant owner; used as their login identity.

first_name.title: First Name
first_name.description: Given name of the tenant owner.

last_name.title: Last Name
last_name.description: Family name of the tenant owner.

password.title: Password
password.description: Initial password for the tenant owner account.

id.title: Id
id.description: Unique identifier of the owner user.

email.title: Email
email.description: Email address of the owner user.

first_name.title: First Name
first_name.description: Given name of the owner user.

last_name.title: Last Name
last_name.description: Family name of the owner user.

min.title: Min
min.description: Minimum allowed value for the parameter.

max.title: Max
max.description: Maximum allowed value for the parameter.

default.title: Default
default.description: Applied when the parameter is omitted from predict. Seeded from the model's train-time VALIDATION split: detection confidence and IoU are swept jointly under serving-identical per-class NMS; segmentation exposes confidence only because its serving postprocessor does not apply mask NMS. max_detections is data-derived (max ground-truth instances in any single val image, floor 10, cap 1000). Deliberately NOT the scorecard's `optimal_confidence`, which is a test-split diagnostic measured without NMS — the two answer different questions and will differ slightly.

PerClassMetrics.title: PerClassMetrics
PerClassMetrics.description: One class's P/R/F1 + GT support at the chosen threshold.

PolygonPart.title: PolygonPart
PolygonPart.description: One part of a (possibly multi-part) polygon: an exterior ring + optional hole rings.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: Confidence threshold; predictions below it are dropped.

max_detections.title: Max Detections
max_detections.description: Maximum number of predictions to return.

geometry.title: Geometry
geometry.description: Typed geometry (bbox/polygon/keypoint) — the same discriminated shape as annotation.geometry, so a prediction maps onto an annotation without translation.

ProjectAnnotationBatchCreate.title: ProjectAnnotationBatchCreate
ProjectAnnotationBatchCreate.description:
Body for `POST /{pid}/annotations/batch-create` — sync, flat mapped list,
all-or-nothing (an invalid row → 422 with its index). Cap
`MAX_SYNC_BATCH_SIZE`. `source` defaults to `manual`.

ProjectAnnotationBulkCreate.title: ProjectAnnotationBulkCreate
ProjectAnnotationBulkCreate.description:
Body for `POST /{pid}/annotations/bulk-create` — async. Provide EITHER
`annotations` inline (bounded by the ~6 MB Lambda request payload) OR an
`import_id` from `import-init` (S3-staged NDJSON, for large imports).
Exactly one. `source` defaults to `imported` (the import path).

ProjectAssetsBatchAddResponse.title: ProjectAssetsBatchAddResponse
ProjectAssetsBatchAddResponse.description:
Canonical sync batch-op envelope (ADR-0041): `total == added + skipped`,
`len(results) == total`. `skipped` = already-in-scope (idempotent re-add).

ProjectAssetsBatchRemoveResponse.title: ProjectAssetsBatchRemoveResponse
ProjectAssetsBatchRemoveResponse.description:
Canonical sync batch-op envelope (ADR-0041): `total == removed + skipped`,
`len(results) == total`. `skipped` = not-in-project, nothing to drop.

ProjectAssetsBatchSetStatusRequest.title: ProjectAssetsBatchSetStatusRequest
ProjectAssetsBatchSetStatusRequest.description: Sync batch set-status. Explicit asset_ids only.

ProjectAssetsBatchUpdateRequest.title: ProjectAssetsBatchUpdateRequest
ProjectAssetsBatchUpdateRequest.description:
Sync `batch-update-tags` body — explicit asset_ids only, ≤MAX_SYNC_BATCH_SIZE.
Same dual-arm shape as the async path; FE picks sync when N≤1000 for
instant feedback, async for larger / filter-driven.

ProjectAssetsBatchUpdateResponse.title: ProjectAssetsBatchUpdateResponse
ProjectAssetsBatchUpdateResponse.description:
Canonical sync batch-op envelope (ADR-0041): `total == updated + skipped`,
`len(results) == total`. `skipped` = asset wasn't in the project, was already
in the desired tag state, or was otherwise filtered out by the WHERE clause.

class_ids.title: Class Ids
class_ids.description: Delete only annotations whose class_id is in this list (ANY-of / IN). Annotation FIELD filter — distinct from the ProjectFilter `classes` asset content-filter. Unknown ids match nothing (entity-ref contract).

source.description: Delete only annotations with this source (`manual` | `imported` | `model`) — e.g. `model` to undo an auto-label run, `imported` to undo a bad import, without touching human work.

asset_ids.title: Asset Ids
asset_ids.description: Assets whose matching annotations are deleted. Explicit ids only.

ProjectBatchDeleteAnnotationsRequest.title: ProjectBatchDeleteAnnotationsRequest
ProjectBatchDeleteAnnotationsRequest.description:
Sync `batch-delete-annotations` body — explicit asset_ids only,
≤MAX_SYNC_BATCH_SIZE (ADR-0041). Additionally 413s when the selection
matches more than MAX_SYNC_BATCH_SIZE annotations (the sync perf budget
bounds deleted rows, not selected assets) — use bulk-delete-annotations.

cleared.title: Cleared
cleared.description: Assets that had ≥1 matching annotation deleted.

deleted_annotations.title: Deleted Annotations
deleted_annotations.description: Total annotations deleted across all assets.

skipped_locked.title: Skipped Locked
skipped_locked.description: Matched annotations left in place because they are locked (ADR-0084).

results.title: Results
results.description: Per-asset outcome, one entry per requested id.

ProjectBatchDeleteAnnotationsResponse.title: ProjectBatchDeleteAnnotationsResponse
ProjectBatchDeleteAnnotationsResponse.description:
Canonical sync batch-op envelope (ADR-0041): `total == cleared + skipped`
over ASSETS, `len(results) == total`; `deleted_annotations`/`skipped_locked`
carry the annotation-level accounting.

status.title: Status
status.description: `cleared` = ≥1 annotation deleted; `skipped` = nothing matched (no annotations, predicate matched none, or all matches were locked).

ProjectBulkAddAssetsRequest.title: ProjectBulkAddAssetsRequest
ProjectBulkAddAssetsRequest.description:
Async `bulk-add` body. `asset_ids` lists dataset asset ids to
pull into the project; `filter` (AssetFilter — dataset-scoped) picks
them by metadata. Exactly one mode. `exclude_asset_ids` (filter-mode
only) deselects rows from the matched set.

ProjectBulkApproveAssetsRequest.title: ProjectBulkApproveAssetsRequest
ProjectBulkApproveAssetsRequest.description:
Async bulk-approve. No payload. Worker silently skips rows not in
`in_review`.

ProjectBulkAssignAssetsRequest.title: ProjectBulkAssignAssetsRequest
ProjectBulkAssignAssetsRequest.description:
Async bulk-assign. `user_id` must be a tenant member (project-member
or tenant admin); route validates at job-create time so the job never
enqueues with a bad assignee.

class_ids.title: Class Ids
class_ids.description: Delete only annotations whose class_id is in this list (ANY-of / IN). Annotation FIELD filter — distinct from the ProjectFilter `classes` asset content-filter. Unknown ids match nothing (entity-ref contract).

source.description: Delete only annotations with this source (`manual` | `imported` | `model`) — e.g. `model` to undo an auto-label run, `imported` to undo a bad import, without touching human work.

ProjectBulkDeleteAnnotationsRequest.title: ProjectBulkDeleteAnnotationsRequest
ProjectBulkDeleteAnnotationsRequest.description:
Async `bulk-delete-annotations` body: ProjectBulkOpRequest selection
(exactly-one-of `asset_ids` | `filter`, filter-mode `exclude_asset_ids`)
plus the annotation predicate. Locked shapes are never deleted (reported
as `skipped_locked` on the job's result_summary).

ProjectBulkOpRequest.title: ProjectBulkOpRequest
ProjectBulkOpRequest.description:
Shared shape for project-scoped async bulk ops. Exactly one of
`asset_ids` (explicit list) or `filter` (ProjectFilter — workflow + tags
+ asset metadata) must be present.

`exclude_asset_ids` (filter-mode only): per-row deselects on top of
`filter`. Worker applies as `NOT IN` against the matched set so the
"select all matching except these few" UX is safe — critical for
destructive ops like bulk-remove which cascade-wipe per-pair
state. Ids not in the matched set are silently ignored.

ProjectBulkRejectAssetsRequest.title: ProjectBulkRejectAssetsRequest
ProjectBulkRejectAssetsRequest.description:
Async bulk-reject. Optional `reason` flows into:
- `project_asset_state.last_reject_reason`
- a new Comment row (anchor=asset, origin=workflow_reject) so the
  labeler sees the same reason they'd see for a single-asset reject.

ProjectBulkRemoveAssetsRequest.title: ProjectBulkRemoveAssetsRequest
ProjectBulkRemoveAssetsRequest.description:
Async `bulk-remove` body. Selection is project-scoped — uses
`ProjectFilter` since you're choosing currently-in-project assets to
drop (workflow + tag fields are meaningful). `exclude_asset_ids`
(filter-mode only) deselects rows from the matched set — critical
because this endpoint cascade-wipes per-(project, asset) state.

ProjectBulkSetStatusAssetsRequest.title: ProjectBulkSetStatusAssetsRequest
ProjectBulkSetStatusAssetsRequest.description:
Async bulk set-status. Force-moves the selection to `target_status`
regardless of current status (manager override — not a guarded transition).
Rows already at the target are silently skipped.

ProjectBulkUpdateTagsRequest.title: ProjectBulkUpdateTagsRequest
ProjectBulkUpdateTagsRequest.description:
Async `bulk-update-tags` body. Atomic — both arms apply in one
transactional batch update. At least one of `tags_add` / `tags_remove`
must be non-empty. Tags are validated against the project's `tag_config`
when `free_form=false` (additions only).

ProjectFilter.title: ProjectFilter
ProjectFilter.description:
Superset of AssetFilter for project-scoped ops. Workflow + tag fields
live on `project_asset_state` rather than the asset row itself.

content_md.title: Content Md
content_md.description: Stored guideline Markdown with image URLs re-signed to fresh 1-hour presigned GETs.

updated_by.description: User who last updated the guideline, if known.

created_at.title: Created At
created_at.description: When the guideline was first created.

updated_at.title: Updated At
updated_at.description: When the guideline was last updated.

ProjectGuidelineResponse.title: ProjectGuidelineResponse
ProjectGuidelineResponse.description:
GET /guideline — what every project member sees.

`content_md` is the stored Markdown with any `guidelines/{pid}/...`
image URLs re-signed to fresh 1-hour TTL presigned-GET URLs so the
labeler's browser can render them without direct S3 access.

content_md.title: Content Md
content_md.description: Markdown source (CommonMark + GFM). 1 MB cap — over → 422 here, 413 on the route. Image URLs in the doc should point at `guidelines/{project_id}/...` from this project's upload-init flow.

ProjectGuidelineUpdate.title: ProjectGuidelineUpdate
ProjectGuidelineUpdate.description: PUT /guideline body. Manager-only on the route.

ProjectProgress.title: ProjectProgress
ProjectProgress.description: Counters from project_asset_state for a project's dashboard.

dataset_id.title: Dataset Id
dataset_id.description: Id of the dataset this project labels.

dataset_name.title: Dataset Name
dataset_name.description: Dataset name; populated only when the caller JOINed the dataset.

dataset_kind.description: Kind of the backing dataset (image or video).

assignment_mode.description: How assets are assigned to labelers (self_claim or manual).

status.description: Project lifecycle status. User-facing reads only ever see `active` — a deleted project is tombstoned `deleting` and immediately excluded from all reads while its cascade runs in the background (ADR-0120).

progress.description: Workflow counters for dashboard cards; opt-in (expensive on hot writes).

ProjectScope.title: ProjectScope
ProjectScope.description: Initial asset selection for a project. Exactly one of the three fields.

ProjectTagCreateRequest.title: ProjectTagCreateRequest
ProjectTagCreateRequest.description: Define a new palette tag. 409 if the value already exists.

assets_untagged.title: Assets Untagged
assets_untagged.description: Number of assets the tag was removed from (0 if it was unused).

removed_from_vocab.title: Removed From Vocab
removed_from_vocab.description: True if the tag was also removed from tag_config.allowed_tags (the palette).

ProjectTagDeleteResponse.title: ProjectTagDeleteResponse
ProjectTagDeleteResponse.description: Result of deleting a tag from a project (untag-all + palette cleanup).

count.title: Count
count.description: Assets in the project carrying this tag (0 = defined but unused).

ProjectTagListItem.title: ProjectTagListItem
ProjectTagListItem.description:
One tag in the project's authoritative palette (ADR-0058): its definition
(value + color/display) plus current usage count.

ProjectTagSummaryItem.title: ProjectTagSummaryItem
ProjectTagSummaryItem.description:
One tag value + the count of assets in the target set that carry it.
FE renders tri-state checkboxes from this:
  - count == total          → checked
  - 0 < count < total       → indeterminate
  - tag absent from list    → unchecked

ProjectTagSummaryResponse.title: ProjectTagSummaryResponse
ProjectTagSummaryResponse.description:
Aggregate tag application across a target set. Powers the unified
bulk-tag editor (one checkbox grid replacing the dual-arm add/remove
pickers). Reuses the same `target` shape as `bulk-update-tags` so the
dialog can pass the same payload it's about to act on.

Tags applied to **zero** assets in the target set are simply absent from
the response. Color / display metadata is **not** denormalized here —
the FE reads those from `project.tag_config.allowed_tags` by `value`.
Free-form tag values (not in `allowed_tags`) show up with no color.

ProjectTagUpdateRequest.title: ProjectTagUpdateRequest
ProjectTagUpdateRequest.description:
Rename and/or recolor/redisplay a palette tag. `value` identifies the
existing tag; supply at least one of `new_value` / `color` / `display`.
Renaming rewrites every asset's tag array (merges if `new_value` already
exists).

assets_renamed.title: Assets Renamed
assets_renamed.description: Asset rows whose tag array was rewritten (rename only).

ProjectTagUpdateResponse.title: ProjectTagUpdateResponse
ProjectTagUpdateResponse.description:
Result of a tag update: the final palette entry + how many assets were
rewritten (rename only; 0 for a pure recolor).

ProjectTagsResponse.title: ProjectTagsResponse
ProjectTagsResponse.description:
The project's authoritative tag palette (ADR-0058), each entry with its
color/display and usage count. (Was a bare `list[str]` before v2.)

all.title: All
all.description: Total in-scope tasks: to_label + rework + continue.

QueueStatsResponse.title: QueueStatsResponse
QueueStatsResponse.description: Bucket counts for the labeler's 4-card hero (ADR-0029).

refresh_token.title: Refresh Token
refresh_token.description: A refresh token from /auth/callback or a prior /auth/refresh.

annotation_id.title: Annotation Id
annotation_id.description: Client-owned ID of the annotation, or null if the annotation was hard-deleted.

class_id.title: Class Id
class_id.description: ID of the annotation class this shape belongs to.

type.description: Kind of annotation (bbox, polygon, keypoint, classification).

geometry.title: Geometry
geometry.description: Typed geometry snapshot (read union, ADR-0104); null for classification annotations.

data.title: Data
data.description: Class-attribute values and other annotation metadata.

instance_id.title: Instance Id
instance_id.description: ID linking this annotation to a tracked instance, or null if unlinked.

RevisionAnnotation.title: RevisionAnnotation
RevisionAnnotation.description: One annotation's state as captured in a commit.

submit_seq.title: Submit Seq
submit_seq.description: Monotonic sequence number of this commit within the asset's history.

reason.description: Why this revision was created (e.g. submitted, approved, rejected).

actor_user_id.title: Actor User Id
actor_user_id.description: ID of the user who made this commit, or null if not attributable to a user.

actor_role.description: The committing user's effective project role at commit time, or null.

committed_at.title: Committed At
committed_at.description: Timestamp when this revision was committed.

annotations.title: Annotations
annotations.description: Full annotation snapshot as it existed at this commit.

RevisionDetail.title: RevisionDetail
RevisionDetail.description:
A single commit + the full annotation snapshot at that point — what the
editor renders to view or diff a past state.

submit_seq.title: Submit Seq
submit_seq.description: Monotonic sequence number of this commit within the asset's history.

reason.description: Why this revision was created (e.g. submitted, approved, rejected).

actor_user_id.title: Actor User Id
actor_user_id.description: ID of the user who made this commit, or null if not attributable to a user.

actor_role.description: The committing user's effective project role at commit time, or null.

committed_at.title: Committed At
committed_at.description: Timestamp when this revision was committed.

annotation_count.title: Annotation Count
annotation_count.description: Number of annotations captured in this commit's snapshot.

RevisionSummary.title: RevisionSummary
RevisionSummary.description: One commit in an asset's history (the editor's revision list).

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or null when this is the last page.

RevisionSummaryPage.title: RevisionSummaryPage
RevisionSummaryPage.description: A page of an asset's commit history (ADR-0012 cursor pagination).

properties.description: Extracted asset properties (dimensions, format, EXIF, etc.).

thumbnail_url.description: Presigned GET to the 320px thumbnail. Present only with ?include=thumbnail_url.

image_url.description: Presigned GET to the full-res asset bytes. Present only with ?include=image_url.

SearchHit.title: SearchHit
SearchHit.description: One result row. `similarity` is in [0, 1] (cosine; 1 = identical).

SearchQueryPart.title: SearchQueryPart
SearchQueryPart.description:
One slice of a multimodal query. Exactly one of `text`, `image_uri`, or
`asset_id` must be set per part, matching the declared `type`.

x.title: X
x.description: Click x in ORIGINAL image pixels.

y.title: Y
y.description: Click y in ORIGINAL image pixels.

label.title: Label
label.description: 1 = positive (include this region), 0 = negative (exclude). Refine a mask by adding negative clicks on over-segmented areas, positive clicks to grow it.

points.title: Points
points.description: Click prompts. Positive/negative points that seed and refine the mask.

box.title: Box
box.description: Optional bounding-box prompt [x1, y1, x2, y2] in ORIGINAL image pixels.

suggestions.title: Suggestions
suggestions.description: Zero or one suggestion (SAM returns the best mask for the prompt). Not persisted — the labeler assigns a class and commits via the normal annotation create.

inference_ms.title: Inference Ms
inference_ms.description: Server-side SAM inference time in milliseconds.

type.description: Geometry kind SAM emitted for this suggestion.

geometry.title: Geometry
geometry.description: Typed geometry wrapping SAM's flat polygon output (ADR-0091/0104) — the same shape `annotation.geometry` stores, so the FE commits an accepted suggestion through the normal annotation-create path unchanged.

SkippedDetail.title: SkippedDetail
SkippedDetail.description:
One annotation the bundler couldn't represent (persisted serialization of
`FormatterSkip`). `asset_id` is stringified on write; `annotation_id` is int
(COCO/YOLO) or str (delta/manifest-miss sentinel).

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Seed for the deterministic ratio split.

train_tag.title: Train Tag
train_tag.description: Manual split (ADR-0065): frozen tag marking the train split; null falls back to a seeded ratio split.

val_tag.title: Val Tag
val_tag.description: Manual split (ADR-0065): frozen tag marking the val split; null falls back to a seeded ratio split.

test_tag.title: Test Tag
test_tag.description: Manual split (ADR-0065): frozen tag marking the test split; null falls back to a seeded ratio split.

SplitStrategy.title: SplitStrategy
SplitStrategy.description: Train/val/test split strategy (stored in training-run options JSONB).

TagConfig.title: TagConfig
TagConfig.description:
Per-project tag vocabulary (ADR-0050). `free_form=true` (default) means
the server doesn't enforce; `allowed_tags` is a cosmetic palette.
`free_form=false` rejects unknown tags at bulk-add-tags time.

TagConfigEntry.title: TagConfigEntry
TagConfigEntry.description:
One entry in `tag_config.allowed_tags` on a Project. `value` is the
canonical wire form; `display`/`color` are FE rendering hints.

slug.title: Slug
slug.description: URL-safe unique identifier for the tenant (lowercase alphanumeric with single hyphens).

name.title: Name
name.description: Human-readable display name of the tenant.

owner.description: Details of the initial owner account created alongside the tenant.

slug.title: Slug
slug.description: URL handle (lowercase alphanumeric with single hyphens); unique platform-wide.

TenantCreateMe.title: TenantCreateMe
TenantCreateMe.description:
Body for `POST /me/tenants` — create a workspace as the authenticated
account (who becomes its admin). No owner block: the account exists.

TenantMembership.title: TenantMembership
TenantMembership.description:
One workspace this account belongs to (`GET /me/tenants` item, and the
result of accepting an invitation).

slug.title: Slug
slug.description: URL-safe unique identifier for the tenant.

name.title: Name
name.description: Human-readable display name of the tenant.

created_at.title: Created At
created_at.description: Timestamp when the tenant was created.

description.title: Description
description.description: Optional free-text description; null if unset.

task.description: Task the model performs (detection or segmentation).

model.title: Model
model.description: Catalog model key the run used (e.g. 'rf-detr-nano').

project_id.title: Project Id
project_id.description: Lineage: which project's data produced this model (tenant registry).

training_run_id.title: Training Run Id
training_run_id.description: Training run that produced this model.

project_version_id.title: Project Version Id
project_version_id.description: Frozen project version the run trained on.

metrics_summary.description: Summary evaluation metrics for the trained model.

updated_at.title: Updated At
updated_at.description: When the model was last updated.

name.title: Name
name.description: New display name (unique per tenant, case-insensitive); omit to leave unchanged.

description.title: Description
description.description: New description; send null to clear it, omit to leave unchanged.

TrainedModelUpdate.title: TrainedModelUpdate
TrainedModelUpdate.description:
Edit a trained model (ADR-0072) — name and/or description (partial; send only
what changes). Name is unique per tenant (case-insensitive); `description` may be
set to null to clear it.

epoch.title: Epoch
epoch.description: Epoch index for this point on the curve.

train_loss.title: Train Loss
train_loss.description: Training loss this epoch; null if unavailable.

val_loss.title: Val Loss
val_loss.description: Validation loss this epoch; null if there is no val split.

val_map.title: Val Map
val_map.description: Validation mAP@[.50:.95]; null if no val split.

val_map_50.title: Val Map 50
val_map_50.description: Validation mAP@.50; null if no val split.

val_precision.title: Val Precision
val_precision.description: Validation precision this epoch; null if no val split.

val_recall.title: Val Recall
val_recall.description: Validation recall this epoch; null if no val split.

TrainingMetricPoint.title: TrainingMetricPoint
TrainingMetricPoint.description:
One epoch on the live training curve (ADR-0064). Losses fall out of the
loop each epoch; the val accuracy metrics come from a per-epoch eval pass on
the val split. Any field may be null (e.g. a run with no val split → losses
only).

TrainingMetricsSummary.title: TrainingMetricsSummary
TrainingMetricsSummary.description:
The full scorecard persisted to `TrainedModel.metrics_summary` and echoed
on `TrainedModelResponse.metrics_summary`. Lenient on read (`extra="ignore"`)
so a future added key never 500s a model read; `num_test` is set only on the
final (full) scorecard, so it is Optional.

name.title: Name
name.description: Display name for the training run.

task.description: Task the run trains for (detection or segmentation).

epochs.title: Epochs
epochs.description: Number of training epochs; null uses the catalog default.

early_stopping.title: Early Stopping
early_stopping.description: Stop early on val-loss plateau; null uses the catalog default.

patience.title: Patience
patience.description: Epochs without improvement before early-stop; null uses the catalog default.

split.description: Train/val/test split config; null uses the catalog default.

project_version_id.title: Project Version Id
project_version_id.description: Frozen project version this run trains on.

name.title: Name
name.description: Display name for the training run.

task.description: Task the run trains for (detection or segmentation).

epochs_completed.title: Epochs Completed
epochs_completed.description: Epochs finished so far; null before training starts.

split.description: Resolved train/val/test split config for this run.

error.title: Error
error.description: Failure message when status is failed; else null.

started_at.title: Started At
started_at.description: When training started; null while queued.

completed_at.title: Completed At
completed_at.description: When the run finished; null until terminal.

instance_count.title: Instance Count
instance_count.description: Total annotations of this class (of the task geometry).

task.description: Task these stats are computed for.

images_trainable.title: Images Trainable
images_trainable.description: Detection: all (empties = negatives); segmentation: images with >=1 mask.

images_empty.title: Images Empty
images_empty.description: Images with no annotation of the task geometry.

instances_total.title: Instances Total
instances_total.description: Total annotation instances of the task geometry.

TrainingStatsResponse.title: TrainingStatsResponse
TrainingStatsResponse.description:
Pre-train readiness for one task on a frozen version (ADR-0064). The FE
renders this and raises its own advisory warnings; the BE only hard-blocks
genuine impossibility at create time.

id.title: Id
id.description: Server-generated unique identifier of the dataset.

name.title: Name
name.description: Human-readable display name of the dataset.

description.title: Description
description.description: Optional free-text description of the dataset; null if unset.

created_by.title: Created By
created_by.description: Identifier of the user who created the dataset; null if unknown or system-created.

created_at.title: Created At
created_at.description: UTC timestamp when the dataset was created.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: Discriminator for the dataset kind; lets the FE route to the correct kind-specific endpoint.

UnifiedDatasetResponse.title: UnifiedDatasetResponse
UnifiedDatasetResponse.description:
Returned by the cross-kind list endpoint. `kind` discriminator lets the FE
route to the correct kind-specific endpoint for follow-up calls.

UserRoleUpdate.title: UserRoleUpdate
UserRoleUpdate.description:
Body for PATCH /users/{user_id}. Admin-only — changes the target
user's workspace role. Blocked by last-admin guard when demoting.

email.title: Email
email.description: Email address of the account to create.

first_name.title: First Name
first_name.description: Given name (no sign-up form runs on this path).

UserSeedCreate.title: UserSeedCreate
UserSeedCreate.description:
Body for `POST /users` — programmatic seeding ONLY (ADR-0113): create a
ready-to-login member directly (WorkOS account with password + membership,
no email). Humans join via `/tenants/{slug}/invitations` + in-app accept.

first_name.title: First Name
first_name.description: Updated given name. Omit to leave unchanged.

last_name.title: Last Name
last_name.description: Updated family name. Omit to leave unchanged.

UserSelfUpdate.title: UserSelfUpdate
UserSelfUpdate.description:
Edit your own profile (first/last name only). Email + password have their
own dedicated endpoints.

UserSummary.title: UserSummary
UserSummary.description:
Compact user reference for embedding in other responses (members,
asset_state, etc.) so the FE doesn't have to do N+1 lookups for names.

VersionAssetDetail.title: VersionAssetDetail
VersionAssetDetail.description:
Single frozen asset (`GET …/versions/{vid}/assets/{aid}`) — the browse view
plus the frozen annotation shapes, read straight from the manifest so it
resolves even for a `version_only` (deleted) asset.

VersionAssetPage.title: VersionAssetPage
VersionAssetPage.description:
Page of a version's frozen assets (`GET …/versions/{vid}/assets`). Mirrors
`AssetPage` — cursor-paginated, `total` is the count matching the q/tags
filter (the whole frozen set when unfiltered).

VersionAssetView.title: VersionAssetView
VersionAssetView.description:
One asset as it was *frozen* in a version (ADR-0065 browser) — served from
the manifest, not the live row, so it survives the asset being deleted.

project_id.title: Project Id
project_id.description: Id of the project this version snapshots.

status.description: Build status of the version (pending, building, ready, or failed).

frozen_asset_count.title: Frozen Asset Count
frozen_asset_count.description: Number of assets frozen into this version.

frozen_class_count.title: Frozen Class Count
frozen_class_count.description: Number of classes frozen into this version.

error.title: Error
error.description: Failure message when status is failed.

created_by.title: Created By
created_by.description: User who created the version, if known.

completed_at.title: Completed At
completed_at.description: When the version build completed, if done.

VersionSelection.title: VersionSelection
VersionSelection.description:
Which of the project's in-scope assets to freeze into a version
(ADR-0065 §4). Exactly one of the three; omit the whole `selection` (or use
`all: true`) to freeze every in-scope asset (the default). `asset_ids` and
`filter` are intersected with the project's in-scope, non-deleted assets.

VersionUpdate.title: VersionUpdate
VersionUpdate.description:
Edit a version (ADR-0072) — name and/or description (partial; send only what
changes). Name is unique per project (case-insensitive); `description` may be set
to null to clear it. Does not touch the frozen snapshot.

image.description: The image to run prediction on.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: One slider mapped to both ZERO thresholds.

ErrorCode.description: Stable error code enum. Pattern-match here, never on `message`. Adding values is non-breaking; renaming/removing is a major bump.

message.description: Human-readable; free to evolve. Don't pattern-match on this.

hint.description: When present, a concrete next step (often references a CLI command).

details.description: Per-`code` structured payload; schema documented per code.

request_id.description: Correlation id for support / log lookups.
